description: Search already-publishable French home-insurance documentary facts with explicit domain synonyms (theft/burglary, leak detection, pipe repairs, etc.). All remaining meaningful terms must match; interpretation is returned and an ambiguous plumber/leak question asks for clarification. Start with query such as recherche fuite or vol bijoux; omit query to browse. Results include exact product/formula, dated document version, conditions and source URLs/pages. Other insurance lines are not covered. No match never means excluded coverage; no current offer or personalized recommendation.

formula_id.description: Exact formula_id from a result. Product-level facts are never inherited.

name: search_insurance_facts
